tokyo_niigata_jizake_to_shunko.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own official Gnavi pages (g087438.gorp.jp is the shop's site; the menu pages live at r.gnavi.co.jp/0000038287/menu1–8), checked 2026-08-20. The shop is a Niigata regional izakaya three minutes from Shinjuku-sanchome on the Suehirotei street; the sake list is the real draw — over thirty Niigata flasks, several of them 地元限定 bottles rarely poured in Tokyo.

items.ja: 珍味盛合せ
items.en: Assorted delicacies — the shop's own recommendation: firefly squid in soy, Kasuke-san's squid shiokara, and flounder-fin tartare, three on a plate
items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: 沖漬け＝醤油漬け。The 沖漬け component is squid cured in soy by definition.

items.ja: 鮮魚なめろう
items.en: Namero — raw fish chopped on the board with miso and spring onion until it turns to paste
items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: 味噌の種類が未記載。Namero is fish and miso — ask which miso, as a 麦味噌 would be barley.

items.ja: えんがわユッケ風
items.en: Flounder-fin 'yukke' — the fatty fin muscle dressed Korean-style with sesame oil and egg yolk
items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: ユッケのタレ＝醤油・コチュジャン。Yukke dressing is soy, and gochujang carries wheat. Raw egg yolk.

items.ja: ホタルいか沖漬け
items.en: Firefly squid cured whole in soy
items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: 沖漬け＝醤油漬け。Okizuke means cured in soy sauce.

items.ja: 牛たん炙り焼き
items.en: Seared beef tongue
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 味付けが未記載（塩かタレか）。The menu does not say whether it is salted or tare-glazed — ask for 塩.

items.ja: とりつくね串焼き（2本）
items.en: Chicken meatball skewers, two — tare or salt, your choice
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: つくねのつなぎに小麦、タレ＝醤油。Tsukune uses a wheat or starch binder and the tare is soy; even the salt version shares the tare grill.

items.ja: えいひれ炙り焼き
items.en: Seared dried ray fin with mayonnaise — the classic thing to chew while drinking
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 干しエイヒレの下味が未記載。Dried ray fin is often pre-seasoned with mirin and soy — ask. Mayonnaise contains egg.

items.ja: だしまき玉子焼き
items.en: Dashi-rolled omelette, served straight out of the pan while it is still fluffy
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 出汁巻きの出汁に薄口醤油が入るのが一般的。The dashi is normally seasoned with light soy — ask. Egg.

items.ja: ししゃも炙り焼き（3尾）
items.en: Grilled shishamo smelt, three fish, roe in
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 塩干しを焼くだけ。Salt-cured and grilled, no sauce applied. Ask that nothing is brushed on and that the grill is not shared with tare skewers.

items.ja: 北海道 氷下魚炙り焼き（3尾）
items.en: Grilled Hokkaido komai (saffron cod), three
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 干物を炙るだけ。A dried fish, grilled plain — but it will arrive with mayonnaise or soy on the side, which are not.

items.ja: 自家製メンチかつ
items.en: House menchi-katsu — breaded minced-meat patty, deep-fried
items.note: パン粉＝小麦、共用フライヤー、ソースも小麦。Breadcrumbs, shared fryer, wheat sauce.

items.ja: ちくわ磯辺揚げ
items.en: Chikuwa fish tube fried in a green-nori batter — the textbook version
items.note: 磯辺揚げの衣＝小麦、ちくわのつなぎにも澱粉。Wheat batter, and the chikuwa itself carries starch binder.

items.ja: 天ぷら盛合せ
items.en: Assorted tempura — the shop suggests it alongside the hegi soba
items.note: 衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油。Wheat batter, soy dip.

items.ja: 揚げ出し豆腐
items.en: Agedashi tofu with nameko mushrooms — a big seller here
items.note: つゆ＝出汁と醤油、共用フライヤー。Dashi-soy broth and a shared fryer.

items.ja: 栃尾の油揚げ（ねぎ味噌／納豆）
items.en: Tochio abura-age — Niigata's astonishing 5cm-thick fried tofu slab, grilled and filled with either spring-onion miso or natto. Half or full size
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: ねぎ味噌の味噌種別、納豆のタレが未記載。¥580 is the ねぎ味噌 half; full size also available. Ask which miso, and whether the natto comes with its soy tare.

items.ja: のっぺ
items.en: Noppe — the Niigata New Year dish: root vegetables simmered together, made whenever a crowd gathers
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 煮汁＝出汁と醤油、貝柱やいくらが入ることも。Dashi-and-soy simmer, and noppe usually carries dried scallop or salmon.

items.ja: 越後地鶏の串かつ２本
items.en: Echigo free-range chicken cutlet skewers, two, with curry sauce
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 衣＝パン粉、カレーソース＝小麦ルウ。Breadcrumbs and a wheat-roux curry sauce.

items.ja: のど黒 姿 漁師煮付け／天然塩炙り焼き
items.en: Whole nodoguro (blackthroat seaperch) sent up from Niigata — simmered fisherman-style, salt-grilled, or as sashimi. Size varies with the catch
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 煮付けは甘辛い濃い醤油味＝小麦。塩炙りなら塩のみ。The shop states the 煮付け is a strong sweet-soy simmer — that one is out; the 天然塩炙り焼き salt-grilled version is the one to ask for. Price from ¥2,200 for a whole fish.

items.ja: 新潟地魚ぼんや自慢！あら煮大根
items.en: The house ara-ni — fish collars and heads simmered sweet and salty with daikon. A best-seller; extra daikon ¥100 a slice
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 甘辛な醤油の味付けと店が明記。The shop states outright it is a sweet-salty soy seasoning.

items.ja: 越の鶏炙り焼き
items.en: Seared Koshi-no-tori, the Niigata heritage chicken
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 味付けが未記載。Seasoning not stated — ask for 塩 rather than tare.

items.ja: 越の鶏「モモ肉」ジューシー唐揚げ
items.en: Fried Koshi-no-tori thigh — a best-seller, served straight out of the oil
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 下味に醤油、衣に粉、共用フライヤー。Soy marinade, flour coating, shared fryer.

items.ja: 佐渡一夜干しスルメ烏賊 炙り焼き
items.en: Overnight-dried Sado squid, seared — the shop says the Sado squid stays soft
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 一夜干しは塩水に浸けて干すのみ。An overnight-dry is brine and air, then a grill — no soy in the process. The mayonnaise and soy that arrive alongside are not; keep them off.

items.ja: 佐渡 丸干し烏賊（肝入り）炙り焼き
items.en: Whole sun-dried Sado squid with the liver left in, seared. Made for sake
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 生烏賊を肝ごと天日干しにしただけ、と店が明記。The shop states it is raw squid sun-dried with the liver in — nothing added. Ask for it without the soy on the side.

items.ja: かすけさんちの イカ塩辛
items.en: Kasuke-san's hand-made squid shiokara, made with no additives at all
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 「添加物一切不使用」と店が明記。The shop states no additives whatsoever, which makes wheat unlikely — but shiokara is often finished with a splash of sake or soy, so ask the maker's spec before relying on it.

items.ja: 寒ずり明太子
items.en: Mentaiko cured with kanzuri — the Myoko chilli paste fermented in snow with sea salt, yuzu and koji. Mellow heat and a yuzu finish; a best-seller
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: かんずりは唐辛子・塩・柚子・糀のみだが、明太子の漬け込み液は未記載。Kanzuri itself is chilli, salt, yuzu and koji, but the roe's own curing liquor normally carries soy and sake — ask.

items.ja: 新潟 たれカツ
items.en: Tare-katsu — Niigata City's own cutlet: pounded thin, fried, then dunked whole in sweet soy. The local soul food
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 衣＝パン粉、甘辛醤油ダレにくぐらせる。Breadcrumbs plus a sweet-soy dunk — wheat twice over.

items.ja: サーモンの塩辛
items.en: Salmon shiokara — fatty salmon rested in salt koji until it turns soft and creamy
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 塩糀＝米麹と塩。Shio-koji is rice koji and salt, which would be clean, but the shop does not publish the full recipe — ask.

items.ja: 新潟地魚 海鮮丼
items.en: Niigata seafood rice bowl — Japan Sea fish, sweet shrimp, salmon and ikura. Comes with miso soup and pickles
items.note: いくらは醤油漬け、かけ醤油付き。The ikura is soy-cured and the bowl is dressed with soy.

items.ja: 新潟 たれカツ丼
items.en: Tare-katsu over rice, with miso soup and pickles
items.note: 衣＝パン粉、甘辛醤油ダレ。Breadcrumbs and sweet soy.

items.ja: じゃこと大葉の焼きおにぎり
items.romaji: jako to oba no yaki onigiri
items.en: Grilled rice ball with whitebait and shiso — one, and it smells wonderful
items.note: 焼きおにぎりは醤油を塗って焼く。A yaki-onigiri is brushed with soy before grilling. ¥230 in the 〆 list, ¥380 in the onigiri list — the size differs.

items.ja: 海苔のおむすび（塩／焼き鮭／辛味噌／梅干／明太子）
items.en: Big old-fashioned rice balls in nori — plain salt ¥350, spicy miso ¥400, umeboshi ¥430, salmon ¥480, mentaiko ¥480. The shop jokes they are the size of the ones in folk tales
items.note: 塩むすびは米・塩・海苔のみ。The plain salt one is rice, salt and nori — ask that nothing else goes on. The 辛味噌 and 明太子 fillings carry miso and cured roe; the salmon is fish.

items.ja: 各種お茶漬けセット
items.en: Ochazuke — plain nori ¥450, grilled salmon / umeboshi / mentaiko ¥530
items.note: 出汁＝鰹、醤油入りが一般的。Bonito dashi, normally with soy in it.

items.ja: アサリのお味噌汁
items.en: Clam miso soup, for when you want something in a bowl
items.note: 味噌の種類が未記載。Miso type unpublished — ask, since a 麦味噌 would be barley. Clams.

items.ja: へぎそば（2〜3人盛り）
items.en: Hegi soba from Tokamachi — soba bound with funori seaweed instead of wheat, laid in one-bite coils on a long wooden 'hegi' box and shared around the table. 2–3 people
items.note: つなぎは布海苔だが、打ち粉と麺つゆが小麦、市販のへぎそばも小麦粉を含むのが通例。The binder being seaweed does NOT make this gluten-free: the dusting flour on the board is wheat, the tsuyu is wheat soy, and hegi soba is normally still cut with wheat flour. 4〜5人盛り ¥3,700。

items.ja: ミニミニ笹だんご
items.en: Mini sasa-dango — Niigata's mugwort rice cakes wrapped in bamboo grass, two
items.note: 笹団子は米粉と餡が基本だが、市販品は小麦粉を混ぜるものがある。Sasa-dango is normally glutinous rice flour and bean paste, but commercial versions sometimes cut it with wheat flour — ask.

items.ja: 新潟たれかつ定食
items.en: Tare-katsu lunch set — the shop's own recommendation at lunchtime
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: 衣＝パン粉、タレ＝甘辛醤油。Breadcrumbs and sweet soy.

items.ja: 新潟地魚の海鮮丼定食
items.en: Seafood bowl lunch — Japan Sea fish, sweet shrimp, salmon, ikura
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: いくらの醤油漬けとかけ醤油。Soy-cured roe and soy dressing.

items.ja: へぎ盛り天ぷらそば定食
items.en: Hegi soba with tempura lunch — prawn, chikuwa and okra, plus as much white rice as you like
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: そば・天ぷら・つゆの三重に小麦。Wheat three ways: the soba, the batter and the tsuyu.

items.ja: 週替りドゥ定食（おかず２点）
items.en: Weekly two-dish set — the cheap regulars' lunch, mentaiko included. One week it was pork belly in the house sauce and salt-grilled mackerel
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: 内容が毎週変わるため一概に言えない。Contents change weekly — ask on the day. Most weeks include at least one soy-seasoned dish.

items.ja: ワンプレート定食（３点のおかず）
items.en: One-plate lunch, three dishes — one week it was sashimi, grilled beef tongue with spring onion, and a croquette
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: 内容が毎週変わる。Contents change weekly — ask.

items.ja: 三元豚ロースのカツカレー定食
items.romaji: sangenton roosu no katsu karee teishoku
items.en: Sangen pork cutlet curry set — medium heat, round-tasting with a spice lift
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: カレールウも衣も小麦。Wheat roux and breadcrumbs.

items.ja: 牛たんとタンシチュー定食
items.en: Beef tongue and tongue-stew set — grilled tongue, stewed tongue and grated yam, with free rice refills
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: シチューのルウ＝小麦。The stew is thickened with a wheat roux.

items.ja: 自家製ハンバーグ定食
items.en: House hamburg steak set — the shop warns the sauce will cost you a second bowl of rice
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: つなぎのパン粉とソース＝小麦。Breadcrumb binder and wheat sauce.

items.ja: 三元豚ロースの煮カツ定食
items.en: Simmered pork cutlet set — cutlet, tofu and onion bound with egg
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: 衣＋割下＝小麦、卵とじ。Breadcrumbs, soy broth and egg.

items.ja: かきフライ定食
items.en: Fried oyster set with tartare sauce — a winter lunch
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: パン粉＝小麦、タルタルソース＝卵。Breadcrumbs, shared fryer, egg-based tartare.

items.ja: レジェンド３梅利き酒セット
items.en: The Three Plums tasting flight — Koshi-no-Kanbai, which set off the whole Niigata sake boom; Setchubai, sharp and full; and Mine-no-Hakubai, light. 3 × 60ml
items.section: 利き酒セット Tasting flights
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。Sake is rice and rice koji; no allergen line is published, so ask if you are strict. The single best-value way into this list.

items.ja: 越乃雪月花 利き酒セット
items.en: Setsugekka flight — junmai daiginjo, junmai and honjozo from the Myoko brewery, side by side. 3 × 60ml
items.section: 利き酒セット Tasting flights
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。The Joetsu style is soft and slightly sweet.

items.ja: 越乃寒梅 白ラベル（新潟市）
items.en: Koshi-no-Kanbai White Label — the bottle that started the Niigata boom. Clean, bracingly dry. 1合 flask
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。Rice sake.

items.ja: 雪中梅 ふつう酒（上越市）
items.en: Setchubai regular-grade — soft, sweet-leaning, made on Kubiki's good water
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加（通常サトウキビ由来）。Futsushu has added distilled alcohol, normally cane-derived, but it is not labelled.

items.ja: よしかわ杜氏 大辛口（上越市）
items.en: Yoshikawa Toji, very dry — easy to drink but with real body. The shop says take it warm
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。One of the cheapest flasks on the list.

items.ja: かたふね 特別本醸造（上越市）
items.en: Katafune special honjozo — the rice sweetness opens out and then vanishes
items.note: 本醸造は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 吟田川 特別純米（上越市）
items.en: Chibitagawa special junmai — distinctive, broad, full of umami
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。Rice and rice koji only.

items.ja: 鮎正宗 純米（妙高市）
items.en: Ayumasamune junmai from Myoko — mild, refined, gently sweet
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 越乃雪月花 純米大吟醸（上越市）
items.en: Setsugekka junmai daiginjo — round, generous, nothing sharp about it
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝高精白の米と米麹。

items.ja: 八海山 魚沼で候 純米（地元限定酒・南魚沼市）
items.en: Hakkaisan 'Uonuma de Sourou' — a junmai sold only inside the Uonuma region, and rarely seen in Tokyo
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹。地元限定酒。A region-only release.

items.ja: 八海山 ふつう酒（地元限定酒・南魚沼市）
items.en: Hakkaisan regular-grade — another local-only bottle. The shop notes you almost never see the futsushu in Tokyo, and warns you will drink too much of it
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 鶴齢 雪男 本醸造（南魚沼市）
items.en: Kakurei 'Yukiotoko' honjozo — built for eating with
items.note: 本醸造は醸造アルコール添加。

items.ja: 麒麟山 純米（東蒲原郡）
items.en: Kirinzan junmai — the shop's own pick: light, round, a touch of bitterness, and a clean cut
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。Flagged おすすめ by the shop.

items.ja: 麒麟山 伝辛（東蒲原郡）
items.en: Kirinzan Denkara — the dry everyday one, and the base of the shop's Kirinzan sour
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 白瀧 湊屋藤助 純米大吟醸（南魚沼市）
items.en: Shirataki 'Minatoya Tosuke' junmai daiginjo — from the Jozen Mizu-no-Gotoshi brewery, fruity and easy
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 緑川 純米（魚沼市）
items.en: Midorikawa junmai — an aromatic yeast; one of the most sought-after junmai in the prefecture
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 鶴の友 純米（地元限定酒・新潟市）
items.en: Tsuru-no-Tomo junmai — another local-only bottle; light with a faint fruitiness
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹。地元限定酒。

items.ja: 久保田 萬寿 純米大吟醸（長岡市）
items.en: Kubota Manju — the top of the Kubota range and the most expensive flask here
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 久保田 千寿 吟醸（長岡市）
items.en: Kubota Senju ginjo — the one everyone has heard of
items.note: 吟醸は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 〆張鶴 純 純米吟醸（村上市）
items.en: Shimeharitsuru 'Jun' junmai ginjo from Murakami
items.note: 純米吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 〆張鶴 花 ふつう酒（地元限定酒・村上市）
items.en: Shimeharitsuru 'Hana' — the dry local-only regular grade the shop calls the one that never lets you down
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。地元限定酒。

items.ja: 菊水ふなぐち一番しぼり 本醸造生原酒（新発田市）
items.en: Kikusui Funaguchi — the unpasteurised undiluted honjozo from the famous gold can
items.note: 本醸造生原酒。Unpasteurised and undiluted; added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 越乃景虎 名水仕込み 特別純米（長岡市）
items.en: Koshi-no-Kagetora special junmai, brewed on the spring water of Todoro-no-Mori — one of Japan's hundred famous waters
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 吉乃川 厳選辛口（長岡市）
items.en: Yoshinogawa dry — smooth, umami-forward, clean finish. Cheap and reliable
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 天神囃子 ふつう酒（十日町市）
items.en: Tenjinbayashi regular-grade from Tokamachi — polished to ginjo levels at 60% despite the grade
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。

items.ja: 田友 特別純米（小千谷市）
items.en: Denyu special junmai — dry-leaning but built around the rice's own flavour
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 北雪「鬼ころし」超辛口（佐渡）
items.en: Hokusetsu 'Onikoroshi' — Sado island's version of the ultra-dry demon-killer
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 越乃寒梅 米焼酎 5年熟成古酒
items.en: Koshi-no-Kanbai rice shochu, 5 years old, 40% — refermented from daiginjo lees, so it smells of the sake it came from. By the glass
items.section: 新潟米焼酎 Niigata rice shochu
